documents.title: Incident 123: Auth service outage
documents.content: The authentication service failed after deployment 456. The database connection pool was exhausted because DB_POOL_SIZE was reduced from 100 to 10.

documents.title: Deployment 456 changelog
documents.content: Deployment 456 reduced DB_POOL_SIZE from 100 to 10 to save memory.

documents.title: Auth outage runbook
documents.content: For authentication failures after a deployment, inspect DB_POOL_SIZE first, restore it to 100, and redeploy.
